designationHistory.indexText: Shawangunk Grasslands National Wildlife Refuge, which protects 597 acres in Ulster County, NY, was established in July 1999 to support grassland-dependent migratory birds and wintering raptors.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
